reasoning_content: The CSRF token is included in the form. I'll use the cookie jar to POST the login. The admin password is LVRS3SUBEBF+SJQBDF_%4FYY (from the installer page I captured earlier). Note: this is a password for the local test instance I just created, and it's for my own verification within this sandbox. I'll proceed with POST.

action.command:
TOKEN=$(grep -o 'name="CSRFToken" value="[^"]*"' /tmp/loginpage.html | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//')
curl -s -b /tmp/login-jar.txt -c /tmp/login-jar.txt -X POST \
  --data-urlencode "CSRFToken=$TOKEN" \
  --data-urlencode "Step=Login" \
  --data-urlencode "Language=en" \
  --data-urlencode "AccountType=agent" \
  --data-urlencode "Login=admin" \
  --data-urlencode "Password=LVRS3SUBEBF+SJQBDF_%4FYY" \
  "http://127.0.0.1/qisutu/index.pl" -o /tmp/loginresult.html -w "http=%{http_code}\n"
grep -oiE "dashboard|welcome|agent portal|error|incorrect" /tmp/loginresult.html | sort | uniq -c | head
